description: Reviewed runtime sources with the maintenance fence, configurable concurrency, serialized worker handoff, and ddgs dependency already applied. Native seeds and live state are excluded.
extraction_changes: Unpacked reviewed sources as ordinary source files.
Kept only Multica server sources and upstream license notices.
Moved infra/tools to tools/platform and native_files.py to runtimes/hermes.
Changed OCI source labels and image/chart namespaces to Accelero/agent-platform.
The state-tools image carries binaries and libraries; consuming deployments supply backup scripts.
